newsitem.title: UK: IPE Brent crude closes down in light trade.
newsitem.headline: IPE Brent crude closes down in light trade.

text.p: Front month IPE Brent crude oil closed down on the day after loosing ground in the last few minutes of trade, brokers said.
November Brent crude oil closed down 16 cents at $24.70 a barrel, but fared better than December which lost 27 cents on the day to end at $24.11 a barrel.
With no fresh market moving news and amid low volume trade brokers said the market was on hold until the release of overnight weekly U.S. statistics from the American Petroleum Institute (API).
About a half an hour before the close the Brent Nov/Dec spread widened sharply from +50 cents up to +57-60 cents.
"But it was all on a few deals and lost ground again," one broker said.
The November Brent crude contract expires at close on Wednesday.
The weekly U.S. crude and product stock figures from the API are expected to show U.S. heating oil stocks building 0.5-1.5 million barrels for last week.

"Traders are getting very nervous buying oil at these levels, but no-one wants to go short. If we see a draw or only a small build in (U.S.) heating oil stocks tomorrow we'll break back up past $25 (November).
The contract traded to a high of $25.06 on Tuesday.

November gas oil, which closed earlier down some $3.25 a tonne at $230.25 was called to open on Wednesday unchanged to 25 cents firmer on the basis of the Brent crude and NYMEX heating oil closing levels, brokers said.
